name: The Walking Scale
introDiscord:
One Leviathan scale rises from the seabed.

Then another.

Then the first one grows legs.

Shizuki's old warning simply says:

'I KNEW THE SCALE MOVED.'
introTwitch:
One Leviathan scale rises from the seabed.

Then another.

Then the first one grows legs.

Shizuki's old warning simply says:

'I KNEW THE SCALE MOVED.'

the-walking-scale-approach.prompt: Three paths cross a field of enormous overlapping plates.

left.message:
A Leviathan scale lifts upright.

Stone-like limbs unfold beneath it.

You owe Shizuki's paranoia an apology.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath her earlier note:

'Glimmer says scale moved.

I say current moved scale.

Update:

SCALE HAS LEGS.

Glimmer wins.'

forward.message: A strongbox lies beneath an inactive scale.

the-walking-scale-depths.prompt: Pressure-scarred wrecks surround three paths through the moving plates.

left.message:
Shizuki's bottle is labeled:

'Recovery supplies for when terrain stands up.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the terrain-related medical equipment unused.

right.message:
A Scale Golem unfolds from what you were absolutely certain was the
floor.

forward.message:
Star Candies rest beneath a genuine, non-walking scale.

You stare at it for several seconds anyway.

the-walking-scale-threshold.prompt: Titanplate Foundry is surrounded by upright scale formations.

left.message: A navigator's chest rests between two plates.

right.message:
Shizuki's restorative says:

'TESTED THIS SCALE.

Poked twice.

Did not move.

Still don't trust it.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicine and also don't trust it.

forward.message:
A Leviathan Scale Golem assembles itself from three separate plates.

Oh, they can do THAT too.

boss-antechamber.name: Titanplate Foundry
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every loose scale inside Titanplate Foundry begins sliding toward the
center.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every loose scale inside Titanplate Foundry begins sliding toward the
center.

They stack.

Lock.

Rise.

Use /yes to approach the growing structure or /no to leave before the
floor assembles anything larger.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every loose scale inside Titanplate Foundry begins sliding toward the
center.

They stack.

Lock.

Rise.

Use !yes to approach the growing structure or !no to leave before the
floor assembles anything larger.
bossRetreatText: You retreat onto ground that remains responsibly horizontal.

boss.revealText:
Dozens of Leviathan scales form a towering armored body.

Scale-Forged Colossus reveals itself!

completionText:
The Colossus collapses back into harmless plates.

You poke the nearest one.

Nothing happens.

Still suspicious.
